errors.evidence: The categories on the x-axis are not sorted in alphabetical order. The actual order is Pb-Acid, Ni-Cd, Ni-MH, Li-Ion, and Solid State, which appears to be an ascending order based on the energy density values.

errors.text_span: За Pb-Acid синият стълб достига около 40, а оранжевият – около 60; за Ni-Cd синият е около 50, а оранжевият – около 90; за Ni-MH синият е около 70
errors.evidence: This part of the description contains several inaccurate approximations of the bar values. For Pb-Acid, the values are approximately 30 (blue) and 50 (orange), not 40 and 60. For Ni-Cd, the orange bar is approximately 80, not 90. For Ni-MH, the blue bar is approximately 60, not 70.
